snippet.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom DELUXE - Final Trailer
snippet.description:
The final trailer for Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe! Releasing September 20th, 2026!

SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom DELUXE is a full-game mod of the 2003 licensed video game "SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom" (originally developed by Heavy Iron Studios). The mod is developed by myself using Industrial Park, a Battle for Bikini Bottom level editor created by igorseabra4. Features of this mod include:

- 100 brand new Golden Spatulas spread across the original game for a grand total of 200 Golden Spatulas to collect!
- 20 more socks to find for 100 in total!
- Over 30 brand new areas to explore, such as Jellyfish Canyon, Iceberg Seas, The Construction Site, Shipwreck Mountain, and Bonus Challenges!
- New power-ups and collectables, including toggleable Extras!
- Expanded levels and areas!
- Restored beta and unused content such as the Smelly Sundae and the original Patrick's Dream!
- New Game Options to enhance repeat playthroughs, such as Checkpoint Challenge and Sock Remix!
- New bosses to fight, such as the Dirty Bubble!
- Pre-installed bonus levels from across the Battle for Bikini Bottom modding community!
- Quality of life improvements to enhance the original game!
- Various bug fixes!
- A BIG 200% completion reward!
- ...and so much more!!!

Play the demo HERE!
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AhmidbOnkDiQL4AS2tWz88OOjGjIOqkH

Join the official Discord server for more on Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe!
https://discord.gg/2AAUaRArhn

Music used:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRXUzWNdLx8
